newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba says repo exemption means small overall cut.
newsitem.headline: Buba says repo exemption means small overall cut.

text.p: The Bundesbank said its decision to free up repos with maturities of up to one year will only lead to a small cut in the overall minimum reserve requirement.
In a statement the central said it still viewed minimum reserves as an important monetary instrument and would continue to push for their use by the future European Central Bank.
Officially the new ruling will take effect on January 1, 1997, but the Bundesbank said that banks need not take the repos into account for their reserve holdings from December 16, 1996.
